title: Two Factor Review
description: A documented profile of the WordPress.org Two Factor plugin for adding account-level two-factor authentication.
metaDescription: A transparently scoped Two Factor WordPress plugin profile from KreativWP.
highlights: The official directory describes time-based, email, and backup-code second-factor options
The plugin is focused on account authentication rather than a broad security suite
It provides a smaller-scope choice for sites that specifically need stronger login protection
bestFor: Administrators who want to add a second authentication factor without adopting a broader security platform for unrelated tasks.
researchScope: This profile reviews the Two Factor plugin’s official WordPress.org listing.
caveats: Define recovery, offboarding, support, and administrator-access processes before enforcing two-factor authentication for every user role.
